name: Can-Am Maverick R - Yellow Turbo
cardPhotoAlt: Yellow Can-Am Maverick X3 turbo dune buggy driving across Dubai sand
heroPhotoAlt: Yellow Can-Am Maverick R turbo dune buggy on the red dunes at Lahbab, Dubai
blurb: The fastest two-seat machine in the fleet. Experienced drivers only.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Can-Am Maverick R 2-Seater.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Can-Am Maverick R 2-Seater and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Can-Am Maverick R 2-Seater.
